parameters.name: ApisecStatus
parameters.description: The switch of the API security module.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group to which the protected object belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-protection-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --resource-group group1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --apisec-status 1 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
